nodes.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.
A method of determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to a specified parameter.

A classification determined by the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about the environment or context of the mobile device.<SEP>A classification of context data determined from a query, where the type provides information about an environment of a mobile device and may be determined by the meaning of a term of a short message.<SEP>A type algorithmically determined by the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about an environment of the mobile device.

A source that provides the context-data type and is ranked according to a specified parameter.<SEP>A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested; sources may be ranked according to a specified parameter.<SEP>A source that provides a context-data type; sources are algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost, and context data is requested from them.

Data provided by a context-data source, having a cost value and a context-data type.<SEP>Information about an environment of a mobile device that is received from a context-data source and may be ranked, provided to devices, associated with or appended to a short message, or stored in a database.<SEP>Data of a context-data type obtained from a context-data source, possibly by a physical sensor; it may be rendered, appended to a short message, or selected from a weighted list.

A message received from a mobile device, whose terms carry meaning used to determine a context-data type.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device by a server, whose term meaning may determine a context-data type, and to which received context data may be associated, appended, or encoded.<SEP>A message generated by a device to which relevant context data is linked.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device whose terms have meanings used to determine a context-data type; context data may be linked and formatted with it.

A device that generates and sends a short message and may receive context data; its environment is described by the context-data type.<SEP>A device that sends short messages and receives context data through a communication network; context data may be appended to short messages generated by the mobile device.

A system component that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data type determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.<SEP>At least one server that collects a set of context data from at least one context-data provider.
A mobile device that receives context data, may receive a forwarded short message with context data, and may access a database storing the received context data.

A parameter used to rank context-data sources, which may be a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.<SEP>A criterion used to rank context-data sources or received context data, which may include a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, or a state of an available communication network.<SEP>A parameter used to algorithmically rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from a source.
A monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.
A storage system available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored and queried.

A server that stores a database queried for context data associated with a received short message.<SEP>A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to enable access to stored context data.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device.
A language used to encode received context data into a short message.
Instructions appended to query the database for the received context data in the short message.<SEP>Instructions appended to a short message to query a database for received context data.
A request from which a context-data type is determined and which may be generated by a device.

An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter.<SEP>A network whose state may serve as a specified parameter for ranking context data.<SEP>A network through which context data is communicated to a mobile device.
A mobile device that receives a short message and whose state may be a specified parameter.
A type of mobile device that may generate the short message.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method of claim 1.

An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute operations including receiving a short message, determining a context-data type, identifying a context-data source, and ranking the context-data source.

At least one processor in the computerized apparatus configured to execute program instructions to perform the described operations.<SEP>At least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform operations such as receiving short messages, determining context-data types, ranking sources, and generating requests.
At least one memory in the computerized apparatus having program instructions.
Instructions executed by a processor to perform operations including receiving short messages, determining context-data types, identifying and ranking sources, and generating requests.
A provider that is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>A provider from which a set of context data related to a meaning of short message content is collected by a server.
A metric according to which relevant context data is algorithmically selected, comprising a monetary cost of the context data.
A sensor that obtains context-data physically.<SEP>A sensor by which context data is obtained.

A protocol according to which relevant context data and the short message are formatted.<SEP>A protocol according to which relevant context data and the short message are formatted; it may comprise a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol comprising a cellular network short message protocol.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising a cellular network short message protocol.
A type of communication protocol comprising an internet communication protocol.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising an internet communication protocol.
A list of context-data elements weighted according to at least one metric, from which context data is selected.
An apparatus comprising at least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform context-data operations.

A method comprising collecting context data from a context-data provider, selecting relevant context data according to a metric, linking it to a short message, and formatting them according to a communication protocol.
Data obtained by a physical sensor that is linked to a short message and formatted according to a communication protocol.
A device that generated the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.

edges.description: The patent US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The context-data acquisition and ranking method determines a context-data type from a query.
The method identifies at least one context-data source providing the context-data type and generates a request for context data from that source.
The method ranks received context data according to a specified parameter and provides the received context data to devices.
The method ranks context-data sources and received context data according to a specified parameter.
The method associates received context data with a component of a short message and appends the context data to the short message.
The method stores the received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The context-data source provides the context-data type.<SEP>At least one context-data source provides the context-data type.
The context-data type is determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.
